root_cause.text: dwc3_gadget_vbus_draw() is callable from atomic context but directly invokes power_supply_set_property(), which can sleep (e.g., over I2C to a PMIC), causing an illegal context switch and kernel panic.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "Currently dwc3_gadget_vbus_draw() can be called from atomic context, which in turn invokes power-supply-core APIs. And some these PMIC APIs have operations that may sleep, leading to kernel panic." The patch moves the power_supply_set_property() call into a workqueue context via a new work_struct (dwc3_vbus_draw_work) and schedules it in dwc3_gadget_vbus_draw() instead of calling directly.
